verdict.rationale: Twenty documents running on your own infrastructure with a single Docker Compose command. It provides a dedicated self-host guide with a one-line install script and explicitly targets organizations that need to self-host and own their data end to end. A community user reported it was extremely easy to set up, and the AGPLv3 licensing discussion corroborates its open-source availability. Missing for 10: detailed independent hands-on corroboration of production self-hosting (scaling and upgrades beyond the Docker Compose path).
